title: VIP Escalations Intake: Scoped Commitment Algorithm and Capacity Hedging
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary:
This ticket defines a deterministic intake and commitment algorithm for VIP escalations that balances firm commitments against sprint capacity and company-wide SLAs. We will prototype the Scoped Commitment Algorithm (SCA) that converts account signals (contract value, escalation severity, legal commitment) into a timeboxed delivery commitment and an associated capacity hedge (reserve tokens + fallbacks).

Background and problem statement:
Top accounts occasionally escalate with high-impact asks that require faster-than-normal delivery. Current intake is ad hoc: PMs negotiate verbally, engineering pledges vary, and we lack a clear hedging mechanism to prevent schedule surprise. This results in missed expectations, churned priority, and hidden capacity tax on other roadmap items.

Goal:
1) Define an algorithmic scoring and commitment policy that outputs: scope banding, guaranteed delivery window, and required reserve capacity (hedge).
2) Surface escalation commitments in the roadmap with clear trade-offs and automated capacity reservations.
3) Provide an operational playbook (SLA triggers, executive approvals, communication templates) so PM/SE/Eng are aligned on commitment semantics.

Out of scope:
- Rewriting billing or contract language (legal will be consulted but not part of this ticket).
- Full integration with quota/autoscaling engine (this ticket produces an API contract and UI mocks; follow-up ENG work required).
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic SCA calculation documented with inputs and outputs
UI or spreadsheet prototype that shows how an escalation pulls from the capacity reserve and affects roadmap lanes
Operational playbook with approval gates and communication templates
Stakeholder sign-off from Sales lead, Solutions Eng, and Head of Eng
Runbook that maps failure modes and automatic fallback paths (model variant fallback, feature-degradation plan)
success_metrics: % of VIP commitments delivered within agreed window >= 90% in first 90 days
Reduction in unplanned roadmap slippage attributed to escalations by 40% quarter-over-quarter
Time to decision for a VIP escalation reduced to <= 48 hours from intake
Clear assignment of capacity hedge tokens visible on roadmap for each committed item
proposed_solution: Scoped Commitment Algorithm (SCA): numeric score computed from account_weight (ARR), escalation_severity (technical/business), contractual_risk, and delivery_complexity. Score maps to scope_band (Lite/Scoped/Full) and timebox (2/4/8 weeks).

Capacity Hedge Tokens: represent week-equivalents of engineering capacity reserved from the shared pool. Tokens are debited when SCA issues a commitment and auto-expire after the delivery window unless converted to a formal sprint reservation.

Fallback Policy Matrix: for each scope band define automatic fallbacks (degrade non-critical components, switch to compatible model variant, enable feature flags) to reduce delivery tax without yielding the core promise.
Roadmap UI indicators: a compact surge bar on roadmap lanes showing reserved tokens, committed window, and impact on other lanes; clickable drilldown to playbook and approval history.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-reserving tokens leads to underutilized capacity and delayed releases. Mitigation: conservative initial token pricing and quarterly calibration using historical delivery data.
Risk: Sales/Customer perceives algorithm as denying fast timelines. Mitigation: include an override path with executive approval and require explicit customer-facing communication templates.
Risk: Engineering pushback on automated reservations. Mitigation: include opt-out hooks (team-level) and require conversion to sprint reservations before token expiry.
Risk: Complexity of integrating with Dedicated/Private capacity constraints. Mitigation: phase 1 produces API contract; phase 2 ENG work will gate integration with capacity controllers.
implementation_notes: Phase 1 (2 sprints): define SCA spec, build spreadsheet prototype, craft playbook, and mock UI flows.
Phase 2 (3 sprints): API endpoint for reservation requests, integrate token ledger in roadmap UI, and implement basic enforcement (soft warnings).
Phase 3 (post-release): hard enforcement and autoscaling integration for Dedicated customers; metrics export for customer success dashboards.
next_steps: Schedule 60-minute kickoff with Sales Ops, Solutions Eng, Legal, and Head of Eng (owner: Asha)
Draft SCA inputs/weights and run against 6 historical escalations for calibration (owner: Lena)
Prototype spreadsheet and share with stakeholders for feedback by 2026-03-24 (owner: Lena)
Create mockups for roadmap surge bar and approval flow (Design ticket to follow)
